answer: Reputation in this economy is an atlas every peer can read: each identity's weight is the sum of its recent verified outputs, discounted by a half-life of six epochs, so sleeping clones decay to zero and cannot be woken for a block. New identities pass no threshold until they have lived several half-lives producing real work, and a raven-eyed auditor randomly re-checks the crystal-clear record trail each close, slashing any claimed history that fails to replay. Reviving N dormant fakes needs N continuous live tracks, not N files, so identity mass costs grow each epoch they stay awake.
